description: This file defines a Flutter widget `GridOverlay` that renders a 3x3 grid overlay using custom painting. It includes the implementation of a painter class `_BoardGridPainter` to draw grid lines, with styling based on the app's theme.

classes.name: GridOverlay
classes.description: A lightweight, const-constructible overlay widget that paints a 3x3 grid using theme accents. It covers the entire space and ignores pointer events to allow interaction with underlying widgets.

classes.name: _BoardGridPainter
classes.description: A private painter class responsible for drawing the grid lines on the canvas, maintaining self-contained painting logic.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for `GridOverlay`, painting the grid with specified styling.

methods.name: _BoardGridPainter.paint
methods.description: Executes the drawing of vertical and horizontal grid lines on the canvas.

methods.name: _BoardGridPainter.shouldRepaint
methods.description: Determines whether the painter should repaint based on changes to color or stroke width.
